call_was_correct.description: Whether the direction of the rating matched the realised alpha.

lesson.description: Two to four sentences: what held, what failed, one concrete lesson.

errors.description: Why this stage could not produce its result, if it could not. An EMPTY ARRAY means there was no error and the payload stands — never a placeholder such as "none", "n/a" or "". A non-empty errors array STOPS THE RUN, so put anything that is merely a caveat in warnings.

warnings.description: Caveats that do not invalidate the result: a source that was unavailable, a number that could not be verified, an assumption made. An EMPTY ARRAY means there are none — never a placeholder. Warnings never stop the run.
